about_the_game:
Engines at the ready! Hit the highways of American Truck Simulator like never before with the RAM & Dodge Pack, a DLC add-on for the new Road Trip gameplay module! This pack introduces a legendary lineup from two of America’s most iconic automotive brands. Step away from your big rig and into powerful new rides that bring a fresh perspective to ATS, while staying true to the spirit of the open road.

Take the wheel behind:

  • 2025 RAM 1500 Pickup Truck – A rugged and reliable workhorse 

  • 1970 Dodge Charger – A timeless blend of muscle and heritage 

  • 1996 Dodge Viper – A sleek, aggressive machine built for speed 

  • 2023 Dodge Challenger – A modern high-performance icon

With this DLC, you’ll unlock personal cars that offer a brand-new gameplay experience. Want to work? Take on job contracts delivering small packages. Want to explore? Hit the open road freely and earn beautifully designed postcards by visiting iconic locations.

We’re thrilled to partner with RAM and Dodge to bring these legends to life in-game, and we can’t wait to see where your next drive takes you! We're still working on this upcoming game module, so be sure to keep an eye on our official blog and social media channels for all the latest updates! Excited to shift gears?
